title: Disputes of Debt Existence or Amount: Regional Office Review Guidance for Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
A debtor with a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** may dispute at any time that a debt exists or that its amount is correct. A dispute is a challenge to validity, not a request for forgiveness. It is reviewed by the regional office that created the debt within the debt type's dispute review goal.

**Collection during review.** A dispute received within the collection-hold window, in calendar days after the notice date, holds collection until the review is complete.

**Outcomes.**

| Review finding | Effect on the debt |
|---|---|
| The debt is invalid | The whole balance is removed by a balance correction citing the dispute decision, and the debt closes as paid in full |
| The amount is overstated | A balance correction removes the difference |
| Neither | Collection resumes unchanged |

**The waiver window keeps running.** A dispute does not stop the waiver window from running.

### Basis Q&A

**Is a dispute a way of asking for forgiveness?** No. It challenges whether the debt exists or whether its amount is right; forgiveness is the subject of a waiver request.

**Is there a deadline for filing a dispute?** No. A dispute may be filed at any time; only its effect on collection depends on whether it is received within the collection-hold window.

**Hypothetical case.** A debt of 1,500.00 USD is found overstated by 400.00 USD. A balance correction removes 400.00 USD, leaving 1,100.00 USD; the waiver window has run throughout the review as if no dispute had been filed.
